why: B's sofa has light birch legs and the pale green leaf vase fits the cream-and-green palette, so it reads as a more coherent warm Nordic look than A's dark-legged sofa and glam white-and-gold sideboard. Both share the same flaw: a 140 cm table cannot properly seat six 56 cm armchairs, and the 70 cm coffee table is undersized for the sofa and rug.
